mapper.insert: INSERT INTO routine (member_seq_no, title, target_value, daily_limit, routine_type, interval_weeks, days_of_week, start_ymd) VALUES(#{memberSeqNo}, #{title}, #{targetValue}, #{dailyLimit}, #{routineType}, #{intervalWeeks}, #{daysOfWeek}, #{startYmd})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM routine WHERE member_seq_no = #{memberSeqNo} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS' ORDER BY create_at desc
SELECT * FROM routine WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS' AND start_ymd <= #{startYmd}
mapper.update: UPDATE routine SET target_value = #{targetValue}, daily_limit = #{dailyLimit}, change_at = NOW() WHERE seq_no = #{seqNo} AND member_seq_no = #{memberSeqNo} AND status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
